fields.description: What this action does when the rule fires. Guard verbs (Require Fields, Require Location) run synchronously in validate and can block the save; the rest run as effects after commit. Actions run top-to-bottom.
fields.label: Action Type
fields.options:
Require Fields
Require Location
Create Task
Update Field
Append Child Row
Upsert Child Row
Call Webhook
Create Note
Send WhatsApp
Send Email
Wait

fields.description: How the new task's due date is resolved. From Context = read the Due From Field from the trigger context. Expression = evaluate a Python expression (safe_eval) against ctx.
fields.label: Due Mode

fields.description: Schema fieldname whose datetime value becomes the new task's due date. Blank = a default lead time.
fields.label: Due From Field

fields.description: Python expression evaluated against ctx (safe_eval) for the new task's due date - e.g. add_days(ctx['custom_dob'], 7).
fields.label: Due Expression

fields.description: The activity type to raise as an open task when this rule fires.
fields.label: Task Type

fields.description: DocType the field is written to (e.g. CRM Lead). Must be in the Automatable-Field allowlist for this grain.
fields.label: Target DocType

fields.description: The fieldname to set on the target doctype.
fields.label: Fieldname

fields.description: Literal = use the Value as-is. From Context = read the named Context Field. Expression = evaluate a Python expression (safe_eval) against ctx.
fields.label: Value Mode

fields.description: The literal value to write.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: Schema fieldname in the trigger context whose value is written.
fields.label: Context Field

fields.description: Python expression evaluated against ctx (safe_eval) - e.g. add_days(ctx['custom_dob'], 3).
fields.label: Expression

fields.description: CRM Lead child-table fieldname to write into, e.g. custom_lab_profile.
fields.label: Child Table

fields.description: JSON {child_fieldname: value} identifying the row to update; blank match appends a new row.
fields.label: Match (JSON)

fields.description: JSON {child_fieldname: value} to set on the row. Each key must be in the allowlist for this grain. Use "$ctx.<field>" to pull from the trigger context; otherwise the value is literal.
fields.label: Set (JSON)

fields.description: The configured outbound endpoint to call (native Webhook, delivery-only). Admin-curated; the rule only picks it.
fields.label: Webhook Endpoint

fields.description: Literal = use the Comment Text as-is. Expression = evaluate a Python expression (safe_eval) against ctx (must yield a string).
fields.label: Comment Mode

fields.description: The comment text to add to the rule's subject record.
fields.label: Comment Text

fields.description: Python expression (safe_eval) that must yield a string, e.g. f'stage: {ctx["stage"]}'.
fields.label: Comment Expression

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fieldnames on the subject that must be set — a guard action, blocks the save (frappe.throw) if any is blank.
fields.label: Require Fields

fields.description: Optional geofence radius in meters for the Require Location guard. Blank = the existing location.api.location_required check only (no radius).
fields.label: Geofence Meters

fields.description: Python expression (safe_eval) evaluating to a dict of add_to_date kwargs, e.g. {"days": 14} or {"hours": 2}. Parks the remaining actions until now + this delay, for a scheduler sweep to resume (Task 9).
fields.label: Wait Expression

fields.description: The WATI template to send (grain-routed). Dormant unless Task::Automation::sends is on (Task 7).
fields.label: WhatsApp Template

fields.description: Recipient email address for the Send Email action (Task 7).
fields.label: Email Recipient

fields.description: Subject line for the Send Email action (Task 7).
fields.label: Email Subject

fields.description: Body for the Send Email action (Task 7).
fields.label: Email Body
